summary: Audit: subscriptions are disposed idempotently in stop() and start() restarts cleanly; per-element errors are isolated via onErrorResume inside concatMap so one failing sample does not terminate either pipeline. No edits required.
findings: Per-sample errors are swallowed silently (intentional isolation) but unlogged; adding logging would need a new dependency/behavior change, left as is.
Stream is subscribed twice; correct only if eventBus.stream() is hot/multicast.
